definitions: To be selected for military service, often through conscription or a draft.
To be promoted or selected to join a higher-level team or group, especially in sports.
To be summoned to appear in court or for an official proceeding.
examples: He might get called up for the draft next year.
The young player hopes to get called up to the major league team soon.
She could get called up as a witness in the trial.
pastTenses: got called up, gotten called up
